Sorry, it's early. I couldn't sleep again.
Every morning he's out by the barrels before sunrise, typing with his back to the house.
Teddy never got up before ten in his whole life.
Who is he messaging every morning before sunrise?

Nobody I've ever heard of.
He always told us he managed a hotel over there. Mom still tells the nurses "my son, the hotel manager."
Where did he really work in Macau?

Of course it was that kind of place. 😔
Now he wants his share sold in a hurry. Dad always said a man in a hurry owes somebody.
How much does he owe?

That's more than this vineyard clears in three good years.
He keeps saying "the buyers" at breakfast like I'm supposed to know who they are.
Who is he selling his share to?

That's not an offer. That's a eulogy for this place. 💔
Every time I ask when, he says "soon, soon" and changes the subject.
What date does he plan to sign?

He laughed it off. Said he outgrew it.
Then he called himself Moose before I'd even said it. That was Mom's name for him. Nobody else ever used it.
Someone is coaching him.
Who has been feeding him our family stories?

A grown man with a nickname like that. Okay.
Teddy's tractor scar is on his chin. I was nine, I held the towel while Dad drove.
At dinner he touched his face and told the tractor story anyway.
Which scar has he been told to pass off as Teddy's tractor scar?

onboarding.text: My name is Margot Lindqvist. I run my family's vineyard in Sonoma. For nine days I've shared a house with the man I keep calling my brother, and something about him is wrong.
onboarding.label: Margot

onboarding.text: Teddy left for Macau nine years ago. After that it was emails, birthday cards, promises to visit. When he finally walked out of arrivals at SFO and hugged me, I cried in front of strangers.
onboarding.label: Margot & Teddy

onboarding.text: He's thinner now, quieter, and his voice sits lower. He says he manages a hotel over there. He wants to sell his share of our vineyard to an investment fund, and he wants it done fast.
onboarding.label: Teddy

onboarding.text: This morning he left his phone on the porch rail and walked out to the barrels. Now it's in my hand. Help me find out who really came home before I sign anything.
onboarding.label: Margot

Are you eating properly over there?

That's not a diet, that's a cry for help
Lake was like glass this morning. Sending you a picture next time I remember how.
I'd love that. I miss the lake.

Working on it. Maybe sooner than you think.
Oh!! 🙏 Don't tease an old woman
Happy Canada Day, a day late. We had the neighbours over, Gerald burned every single hot dog.

How's your mother? She sounded tired on Sunday.
She's ok. I sent her a bit for the home. She's stubborn about it.
She gets that from my side. You're a good son.
Do you still take the blue pills for your stomach? I found a box in the cupboard from your last visit

Okay. You worry too much, you know. Always have.

Church sale on Saturday. I'm doing the jam table. Raspberry sold out in an hour last year!
Save me a jar, I'll pay you back

Ha. Fair.
Thinking of you this week. Call me when you land safe, wherever that is now.
I will. Promise. Got a bit of travelling to do first.
Your mother says hello and eat a vegetable
Tell her I had a salad yesterday. A real one.
Saturday run? Sunrise at 6:15 at the Coloane trailhead
In. Bringing the dog if that's okay
Dog is fine as long as it doesn't chase the monkeys
No promises 😂
I'm in. Probably coming straight off shift though, don't wait on me
We never wait, we just point at you when you arrive
Great run everyone. 14 km and my knees want a word
Best view yet from the ridge. Pic coming
That last climb is evil
That's why we call it Dessert. You earn it
Heads up: trail closed near the reservoir, fallen trees from last night's storm
Alt route through the village?
Yes, adds 2 km but flat. Good for recovery
I'll take flat
Anyone have spare energy gels? Forgot mine at home
I've got two. Lemon or the awful berry one
Awful berry, my favorite
Trail shoe sale at the sports shop downtown. 30% off. Just saying
My wallet just left the chat
My soles are basically gone, I'll go
Meeting point changed, car park near the Hac Sa beach end
Ok, there in 10
Heat is wild. Don't forget electrolytes, people
Humid week. Light run Sunday, 8 km max?
Please yes
Sorry, I'm out for a bit. Travelling. Run one for me
Where to?
California. Family business
Lucky. Wine country trails are amazing, so I hear
I'll report back
Hope the trip is going well! We did the ridge again, sadly nobody to point at 😂
Ha. Running the vineyard trails in the morning. Dry hills, dusty and quiet. Love it
Photos or it didn't happen
Group buy for race bibs for the autumn trail race. Who's in?
Me!
Probably, but put me down as maybe
Court at 8 on Saturday? Kenji's bringing the good ball.
Can't this week. Family stuff.
You always say family stuff. You don't even have family here 😂
Ha. Next time.
We lost by 12 without you. Rico fouled out in the first half.
Typical Rico.
You alive? Haven't seen you at the court or the noodle place.
Traveling for a bit. Will text when I'm back.
Bring me something American. Beef jerky.
Deal.
Gym is doing a free trial week. Want a buddy pass?
Can't, I'm overseas. Remind me when I'm back
Ok. Your loss, the new bench press is amazing
My shoulders are fine, thanks 😂
Lunch spot on Avenida do Almirante still open Mondays?
No, closed Mondays. Try Tuesday
Good call
Landlord is raising my rent again. Tempted to move to Zhuhai
Cheaper but the border trips will kill you
True. Let me think about it
Watched that documentary you mentioned. Good call
Told you. The ending hits
Took me a while to get over it
You on tonight or tomorrow? Roster app is showing two different things
Tomorrow I think. Check with the floor desk, the app is useless
Yeah the app is a disaster. Fine, tomorrow.
Just finished. Brutal night. Table 12 wouldn't leave
Same guy as last week?
Same guy. Ordered four whiskies and tipped in chips 🙄
At least it's something. Go sleep
Hey have you been to that new ramen place in Coloane Village? Someone said 10/10
No, haven't. Send me the pin if you go. I'll come
Deal. Friday after shift?
Can't do Friday. Next week
Typhoon season already. Third forecast this month
I know. Stocked up on water, batteries, instant everything
You're such a boy scout
Did you see the new uniform memo? Vests again.
I'm not going to dignify that with a reply 😂
Management wants us to look 'fresh'. I look like a bank teller
You still on leave?
Yeah. Sorting some personal things. Sorry, been slow to answer
No worries man. Everyone says hi. Floor's not the same
Tell them hi back. I'll buy a round when I'm back
I'll hold you to that
My sister's wedding is next month, I need a gift idea. You have taste, help
Something useful. Good knives? A nice rice cooker?
Rice cooker. Genius. She'll cry
Get the Japanese one with the induction coil. Worth it
Is it true you went to the States?
Family stuff. I'll tell you when I'm back
Okay okay. Safe flight
Rice cooker ordered. 5 working days they say
Nice. Good choice
It's 5 AM there?? Why are you up
Jet lag, never fully went away 😅
Weather alert for tonight, another one. Be careful out there
Not in Macau right now, but thanks. Stay in
Smart. Talk soon
Did you eat today? You never tell me.
I ate, Ma. Rice and chicken.
Good. The hospital called again about my appointment. I told them I'm fine.
Ma, go to the appointment. Please.
Okay okay. Mrs. Chen from upstairs will drive me.
Thank you for the money last month. I put it in the jar for the heating.
Use it, don't save it. It's yours.
You sound tired. Are you sleeping?
A little. I'll be better soon.
I made your favorite soup. I froze some for you.
Thanks Ma. I'll let you know when I'm back.
Come soon. I don't like when you're far.
I know. Love you.
